name: translation
description: Articles created or largely written with Content Translation (CX) or MDWiki's CX-based translation dashboard: machine-assisted translations, mostly from English. One JSON object per line (translation.jsonl), one per article of the corpus, in corpus order. See quality/translation.md.
source: orwiki-20260901: stub-meta-history (every revision's id, timestamp, contributor, edit summary, size) and the change_tag and change_tag_def SQL dumps (tags on revisions), reduced to raw/orwiki-20260901-article-facts.jsonl.gz; user_groups and user_former_groups SQL dumps (bot accounts); annotate.py translation

columns.ct_created: the page's first revision carries a CX tag (contenttranslation, contenttranslation-v2, sectiontranslation, contenttranslation-high-unmodified-mt-text)
columns.ct_any: any revision of the page carries a CX tag
columns.ct_tags: the CX tags found on the page's revisions (JSON array)
columns.mdwiki_created: the first revision was published by MDWiki's translation dashboard (edit summary 'Created by translating the page [[:mdwiki:...]] to:or #mdwikicx'); CX-based machine translation of medical articles, without a CX tag
columns.mdwiki_any: any revision was published by the MDWiki dashboard
columns.tool_bytes_share: bytes added by CX or MDWiki revisions / bytes of the dump revision (0-1)
columns.translated: use this flag: ct_created or mdwiki_created or tool_bytes_share >= 0.5
columns.translated_at: timestamp of the first CX or MDWiki revision, or null
columns.source_lang: source wiki of the first CX or MDWiki revision (en, simple, hi, mdwiki, ...), from its edit summary
columns.source_title: source page title from that summary (as written, Odia digits as ASCII: may be a user-space draft, e.g. 'User:Mr. Ibrahem/...')
columns.source_revid: source page revision id from that summary, or null
columns.source_section: the translated section when only a section was translated ('opening section' for the lead), else null (Odia digits as ASCII)
columns.created: timestamp of the page's first revision
columns.creator_is_bot: the first revision's account is, or was, in the bot group, or is a global bot (name ends in 'bot')
columns.revisions: revisions up to the dump (the last is the corpus revision)
columns.edits_after_creation: revisions after the first by accounts that are not bots (IP edits count)
columns.bot_edits_after_creation: revisions after the first by bots
columns.editors_after_creation: distinct non-bot editors after the first revision, other than the creator
columns.bytes: size of the dump revision's wikitext in bytes
